variable.description: Libary containing the Agent's load modules

variable.name: TCPIP_HLQ
variable.label: TCPIP_HLQ
variable.description: The HLQ of where TCPIP_HLQ.SEZATCP is installed, required for the Agent STC

variable.name: SKMGMOD0_APF
variable.label: SKMGMOD0 APF?
variable.abstract: Confirm below that the SKMGMOD0 library is APF authorized
variable.description:
The SKMGMOD0 needs to be APF authorized. This is not a part of the workflow. You can check this by issuing a console command like
/D PROG APF, DSNAME=your_library_hlq.SKMGMOD0 (default KMG.SKMGMOD0)

variable.name: AGENT_RUNLIB_READ
variable.label: Access to AGENT_RUNLIB dataset?
variable.abstract: Confirm below that the AGENT_STC_USER can read the AGENT_RUNLIB dataset
variable.description: The AGENT_STC_USER needs READ access to the KMG Agent load library (default KMG.SKMGMOD0). This is not a part of the workflow.

variable.name: CAT_SUPPORT_REQUIRED
variable.label: CAT_SUPPORT_REQUIRED
variable.description: Should the CAT service be enabled?

variable.name: CAT_CORE_DB_URL
variable.label: CAT_CORE_DB_URL
variable.description: Connection to the CAT PostgreSQL database, e.g. jdbc:postgresql://example.com:5432/cat?currentSchema=cccat. The CAT server will create the required tables under the specified schema. If no schema is specified, the default schema `public` is used, which is not recommended.

variable.name: CAT_CORE_DB_USER
variable.label: CAT_CORE_DB_USER
variable.abstract: User ID for CAT DB connection
variable.description: The user ID used to connect to the CAT PostgreSQL database

variable.name: CAT_CORE_DB_PASSWORD
variable.label: CAT_CORE_DB_PASSWORD
variable.description: The password used to connect to the CAT PostgreSQL database, use the security utility, described at https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/was-liberty/zos?topic=applications-securityutility-command to encrypt the password

variable.name: CAT_KAFKA_URI
variable.label: CAT_KAFKA_URI
variable.description: hostname or IP address and port of Kafka server, e.g. example.com:9092

variable.name: ZOAU_HOME
variable.label: ZOAU_HOME
variable.description: Installation location of the Z Open Automation Utility

variable.name: KAFKA_HOME
variable.label: KAFKA_HOME
variable.description: Path to Kafka installation location

variable.name: CAT_AGENT_USER
variable.label: CAT_AGENT_USER
variable.description: User or group that will get access to run the CAT collection

variable.name: CAT_USER_DIR
variable.label: CAT_USER_DIR
variable.description: Location where the adjusted CAT configuration files will be placed

variable.name: CAT_INSTALL_DIR
variable.label: CAT_INSTALL_DIR
variable.description: Folder where CAT is installed

variable.name: CAT_TEMP_HLQ
variable.label: CAT_TEMP_HLQ
variable.description: High level dataset qualifier of MVS work data sets to be used (created and deleted)

variable.name: CAT_SMF
variable.label: CAT_SMF
variable.description: If yes then SMF collect is continued after ICSF collect has been done. Otherwise, no SMF data will be collected

variable.name: CAT_KAFKA_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
variable.label: CAT_KAFKA_TRANSACTIONAL_ID
variable.abstract: unique ID for this UKO CAT agent instance
variable.description: System wide unique ID of UKO CAT agent instance, each deployed instance must have it's own ID

variable.name: SMFGDGBASE
variable.label: SMFGDGBASE
variable.abstract: GDG base for dumped SMF data sets
variable.description: GDG base for dumped SMF data sets for catsmf.conf, if specified, SMFGDGDONE is required

variable.name: SMFGDGDONE
variable.label: SMFGDGDONE
variable.abstract: Latest SMF generation handled, only for SMFGDGBASE
variable.description: Name of the latest SMF generation already handled, must be specified with SMFGDGBASE and will be updated in catsmf.conf after each collection

variable.name: CAT_TEMP_HLQ_ALTER
variable.label: Access to CAT_TEMP_HLQ dataset?
variable.abstract: Confirm below that the CAT_AGENT_USER id or group can modify datasets under the CAT_TEMP_HLQ
variable.description: You have to ensure that the CAT_AGENT_USER id or group can ATLER datasets under the CAT_TEMP_HLQ. This is not part of the workflow

variable.name: CAT_SMF_DATASETS_READ
variable.label: Access to SMF datasets?
variable.abstract: Confirm below that the CAT_AGENT_USER id or group can read the SMF datasets
variable.description: The CAT_AGENT_USER id or group needs READ access to the datasets specified for SMFGDGBASE. This is not part of the workflow

variable.name: CLIENT_CREATE_CA
variable.label: CLIENT_CREATE_CA
variable.abstract: Enable CA creation for the client
variable.description: Flag to indicate if a CA is to be created for the client

variable.name: CLIENT_CA_LABEL
variable.label: CLIENT_CA_LABEL
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CA_LABEL to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CA_CN
variable.label: CLIENT_CA_CN
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CA_CN to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CA_OU
variable.label: CLIENT_CA_OU
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CA_OU to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CA_O
variable.label: CLIENT_CA_O
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CA_O to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CERT_CN
variable.label: CLIENT_CERT_CN
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CERT_CN to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CERT_OU
variable.label: CLIENT_CERT_OU
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CERT_OU to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CERT_O
variable.label: CLIENT_CERT_O
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CERT_O to use for the client.

variable.name: CLIENT_CERT_LABEL
variable.label: CLIENT_CERT_LABEL
variable.description: Name of the CLIENT_CERT_LABEL to use for the client.

variable.name: EXPORT_HLQ
variable.label: EXPORT_HLQ
variable.abstract: HLQ under which the certificates will be exported
variable.description: The certificate will be exported to EXPORT_HLQ.GENERIC_CLIENT_USER

variable.name: EXPORT_PASSWORD
variable.label: EXPORT_PASSWORD
variable.abstract: Password to extract the certificate with
variable.description: Export password for the certificate export

variable.name: EXPORT_PATH
variable.label: EXPORT_PATH
variable.description: Path to where the client certificate and the server certificate shall be exported to

variable.name: KEY_PREFIX
variable.label: KEY_PREFIX
variable.abstract: The KEY_PREFIX for the CSFKEYS class
variable.description: The KEY_PREFIX to be used to generate a profile in the CSFKEYS class

variable.name: UKO_RECOVERY_KEY
variable.label: UKO_RECOVERY_KEY
variable.abstract: The UKO_RECOVERY_KEY for the CSFKEYS class
variable.description: The UKO_RECOVERY_KEY to be used to generate a profile in the CSFKEYS class

variable.name: SAF_OWNER
variable.label: SAF_OWNER
variable.description: Default owner to be used when creating SAF resources

variable.name: REXX_HLQ
variable.label: REXX_HLQ
variable.description: The HLQ of where REXX is installed, namely the SEAGALT dataset, required for loading the pervasive encryption data with KMGUTIL

variable.name: CC_SAMPLIB
variable.label: CC_SAMPLIB
variable.description: Library containing samples for the CC ACSP PARMLIB member

variable.name: CC_LPALIB
variable.label: CC_LPALIB
variable.description: Library containing the CC ACSP SVC modules

variable.name: ACSP_AUTH_MAP_SVC
variable.label: ACSP_AUTH_MAP_SVC
variable.abstract: Number of the ACSP Server security extensions SVC
variable.description: Number of the ACSP Server security extensions SVC which are used for mapping client certificates to z/OS user IDs. This setting is only used if the authorization feature has been enabled by using the auth.check parameter in the acsp.server.properties. The ACSP security SVC must have been installed and this number been specified as SVCNUMDEC. If nothing is specified, then 255 is the default.

variable.name: ICSF_RELEASE
variable.label: ICSF_RELEASE
variable.description: Specify the ICSF release in use, you can find it by issuing the /F ICSF command
